decision: Create separately versioned 0.2.0 historical-proxy successor after Version 8 failed independent semantic verification.
cause: Version 8 retained complete artifacts but 90 of 114 diagnosed Fold 0-1 cells exceeded the frozen 1e-10 date_mean_nll reconstruction tolerance across runtimes, and Fold 2 preprocessing did not reconstruct exactly.
repairs: Persist target-runtime NLL, Brier and coverage score vectors and use explicit ordered scalar reductions for saved reports and date-level inference.
Use explicit sorted scalar train-only median/MAD and fsum standard-deviation reductions for preprocessing.
Give each new fold 4000 seconds for fitting plus mandatory in-run semantic verification while retaining the 13500-second notebook-wide limit.
unchanged_scientific_contract: 19 arms, seeds 11/29/47, folds, horizons, threshold and bootstrap family
private Internet-off Kaggle T4 execution and no protected access
no imputation, row deletion or outcome-driven cohort replacement
pre_execution_gates: new source/release/notebook hashes must be recorded
warning-strict target tests and 19-arm generated qualification must pass
target and independent semantic verification must pass before historical metrics are interpreted
